output.summary: A tree fern native to southeastern mainland Australia, Tasmania and Norfolk Island. Its massive upright trunk supports a crown of long fronds that are dark green above and paler below, while old spiny frond bases often remain around the trunk after withering.
output.edibilityNote: An 1889 account says Aboriginal Australians ate the starchy pulp from the top of the trunk raw or roasted; it was also boiled.
